notes.title: Updated demo version of True Thief
notes.notes:
[p]Friends, by your requests we decided to expand the demo location. In this regard, a number of changes have been added to the demo.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Key changes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The territory of the location has increased, it became 2 times larger, as well as the number of guards on it.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 4 interactive houses with loot and notes revealing the world of True Thief.[/p][/*][*][p]Hiding in the dark has been increased to medium difficulty. Guards can see Enveth better when illuminated, keep an eye on the stealth indicator at the top.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a number of bugs found by players.[/p][/*][*][p]Added full Russian and English voice acting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for wide monitors.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]We hope that now the extended demo will allow players to play longer in the atmosphere of the dark Middle Ages and hide from the guards in the bushes.[/b][/p][p]
[/p]
